[external] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-4 job.artifacts: artifact repository (Argo saves and loads artifacts through an artifact repository, which the files do not configure; set one in the workflow-controller-configmap or with artifactRepositoryRef)

[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-3 step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
